🛰️ **Open Source Tool of the Week: WebODM**

Ever wondered how drone photographs become detailed 3D maps?

WebODM turns aerial imagery into orthomosaics, elevation models, point clouds and 3D landscapes.

🌱 Agriculture
🏔️ Environmental research
📐 Surveying and mapping
🔓 Local, offline processing

Open source isn't just about what runs on your computer. It's about what we can discover with it.

https://webodm.org/

#OpenSource #Linux #WebODM #OpenScience #DroneMapping
